initial_response.final_answer:
RFT 대 SIMUL 압력 막대 Figure는 존재하며, 두 막대가 모든 well에서 일치하지 않음. [FIG2]
범례는 RFT와 SIMUL 두 가지 방법을 사용하여 압력을 비교함. [FIG2]
뚜렷한 불일치 사례는 특정 well에서 RFT와 SIMUL의 압력 값이 차이가 있음. [FIG2]

interpretation of the pressure data.

producing or injection wells using the cased hole version of the wireline formation 
tester.  If a well is killed for a workover and is inactivated by mud, as illustrated in 
Figure 18, the cased hole RFT can be run to measure the layer pressure provided 
the well has been inactivated long enough for the buildup to essentially stabilise.

automatically isolated by the packer, and constitutes an observation perforation for

Figure 60, taken from the paper by Atkinson(20), is a formation pressure survey from 
the first platform water injection well in the Magnus field.  The pressure in lobe 
1 was unexpectedly high having a pressure decline from the central value of only 
250 psi.  This was matched in the simulator by specifying a zero transmissibility 
horizontal barrier between lobes 1 and 2 but with a gap to represent local erosion of 
the shale.  The exact position of this window is expected to become apparent after 
matching to further production history.

producing wells are usually perforated in more than one zone.  When a conventional 
build-up test is carried out there is therefore significant crossflow in the wellbore 
during shut-in.  It is obvious, for example, that well 4 of Figure 60 would have a 
very complicated build-up with layers A and B crossflowing into layers C, D and E 
(presuming F not to be perforated).  The interpretation of such pressure build-ups is
